question: The frustum of a right circular cone has the radius of the base as 5 cm, radius of the top as 3 cm, and height as 6 cm. What is its volume?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base (R) = 5 cm 

Radius of the top (r) = 3 cm

Height (H) of frustum = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of Frustum (V) = 1/3 πH (R² + Rr + r²)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/245969fc4adec048debbac2f657be3ed1f4bf0e75aa8d1207bd635c2a3521d4b.png] 

Volume of Frustum = 1/3 π × 6 × [(5)2 + (5 × 3) + (3)2]

⇒ V = π × 2 × [25 + 15 + 9]

⇒ V = π × 2 × [49] = 98π cm³ 

∴ The volume of frustum is 98π cm3.
